messages:
harper: dropped a quick prototype for discovery-first legend + pin affordance. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/catalog-legend-discovery
jules: love the idea of an inline micro-legend that expands on hover/focus. my concern: if collapsed by default, new users might not know what badges mean. propose a tiny "i" helper with first-run pulse
anika: accessibility: helper must be keyboard reachable and have aria-describedby pointing to the expanded legend. also add a "Don't show again" preference to avoid repeat pulses
harper: for pinning, i'm proposing we de-emphasize row reordering. instead: keep table stable and surface a pinned mini-strip that appears above the table. strip copies minimal metadata and links to row
jules: prefer strip to push content down so screen readers get consistent reading order. also the strip should be reachable via a skip link at top: "Skip to pinned versions"
anika: live region note: when pins change announce "2 versions pinned" with aria-live polite. and animate only if prefers-reduced-motion is false
dev-bot: preview deployed: https://ci.redwood.dev/previews/1955554321 includes micro-legend, pinned-strip, first-run helper
harper: microcopy tweak: badge labels should be human first: instead of "perf:90ms" use "90 ms median latency". tooltip format: "Median: 90 ms · P99: 240 ms · 12,300 qps"
jules: badge design: avoid color-only meaning and use icon + short label. small label must pass 3:1 contrast. if not, use semi-bold text and slightly darker bg token
anika: keyboard: make the mini-legend a button with aria-expanded and focus moves into the legend panel when opened. chips in filters must be tabbable in a predictable order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom)
harper: chip overflow behavior: collapse into a single summary chip like "4 filters" on narrow widths. summary chip opens an accessible panel grouped by filter with clear-per-group buttons and a Clear All action
jules: add undo: when clearing filters show a toast "Filters cleared — Undo" that is focusable and announced via aria-live polite. include keyboard hint when possible
anika: pin affordance: change from icon-only to a small pill "Pin" -> toggles to "Pinned" and uses aria-pressed. also support batch pin: select multiple rows > Pin selected
harper: batch pin UX: modal should confirm and show resulting pinned-strip preview. also support drag-reorder on pinned mini-cards with keyboard move up/down controls
dev-bot: qa reminder: batch-pin API should dedupe and be idempotent under rapid clicks
jules: sorting: allow badge-header small menu to pick sort key (median/p99/cost). default = median latency. persist preference per-user optionally
anika: mobile: pinned strip becomes a bottom tray that can be collapsed. ensure it doesn't conflict with OS gestures; add a grip handle and confirm on iOS Safari
harper: small CSS for focus ring on chips and pill buttons: 
```css
.chip:focus, .pin-pill:focus{outline:2px solid var(--focus); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,112,243,0.12)}
```
jules: copy for share links: snapshots should include pinned state and filters. mark shared view as "Snapshot by <name> — read-only" and offer "Save to my pins" for viewers
anika: added checklist items: legend discoverability, aria-expanded on legend button, chip focus order, toast undo announcement, pin pill aria-pressed, batch-pin idempotency, prefers-reduced-motion support
harper: i'll update the Figma with the collapsed-summary chip, pin-strip push-down mock, and legend-first-run helper. thanks all :thumbsup:
